\# Welcome to Guilds of WoW Help Center!
Welcome to the \*\*Guilds of WoW Support Hub\*\*! Here, you’ll find everything you need to manage your \*\*World of Warcraft guild\*\* effectively.
\## 📖 What is Guilds of WoW?
\*\*Guilds of WoW (GoW)\*\* is a web platform that helps guilds track \*\*roster, raid progress, logs, and recruitment\*\* in one place.
\*\*Here are the core functionalities;\*\*
\*\*Immersive Guild Experience:\*\* Guilds of WoW offers an immersive #WorldofWarcraft experience with enhanced visuals and extensive customization options tailored specifically for guilds.
\*\*Seamless Integration:\*\* Enjoy seamless integration with official Battle.net & Warcraft APIs, ensuring effortless synchronization of your guild data right from the outset.
\*\*Support for Multiple Game Versions:\*\* Whether you're on Retail, Classic Era, or Classic Progression (Cataclysm), Guilds of WoW has you covered with comprehensive support across all versions.

...

\*\*Effortless Event Creation:\*\* Create and manage guild events effortlessly, leveraging bidirectional RSVP synchronization via the WoW calendar and #Discord bot integration.
\*\*Streamlined Discord Integration:\*\* Automate event attendance tracking with the Discord bot, complemented by native Discord events support and a robust role engine.
\*\*Events Calendar:\*\* Keep track of guild and WoW events effortlessly with a personalized calendar tailored to your guild's activities.
\*\*Recruitment Optimization:\*\* Streamline your recruitment process by displaying open spots, filtering potential recruits, and seamlessly redirecting them to your customized application form.
\*\*Recruitment Application Search:\*\* Guild officers gain the ability to efficiently navigate and filter through posted recruitment applications. This feature simplifies the process of finding potential recruits by allowing officers to easily identify applicants who match the guild's criteria and requirements.

# World of Warcraft Classic Guild Management

Blizzard Entertainment · 2019

The definitive classic MMO experience. Organize 40-man raids, manage DKP loot councils, track attendance, and coordinate your guild across multiple raid tiers.

Coming soon · 2019

MMO Classic Raids PvE PvP

## How CoGM support rolls out

World of Warcraft Classic is still early. These phases follow the game’s own schedule, not a fixed CoGM date.

01

### On our radar

World of Warcraft Classic is registered and tracked. We're mapping how its guild systems fit CoGM so we can move quickly once the game opens up.

02

### Core tools at beta

When WoW reaches beta, the essentials come online: roster, events and signups, attendance, applications, and Discord automation.

03

### Full toolkit at launch

As WoW's systems settle, game-specific tracking like gear, loot, and analytics follows.

## Features for WoW

22 features planned forWorld of Warcraft Classic communities.
### Roster Management

Track all members, characters, and roles across your community.

### Events & Scheduling

Schedule raids, PvP events, and social gatherings with signups.

### Attendance Tracking

Auto-track who shows up via Discord voice channels.

### Audit Log

Full history of every action taken in your community.

### Role Permissions

Granular role-based access control with 130+ permissions.

### DKP System

Dragon Kill Points — fair loot distribution based on participation.

### Activity Points

Reward members for all types of community engagement.

### Points Decay

Configurable auto-decay to keep points economies healthy.

### Loot Auctions

Bid on loot drops with DKP — regular or blind auctions.

### Loot Listings

Need/greed loot distribution with priority rules.

### Wishlists

Members declare what items they need for smart loot distribution.

### Item Database

Searchable database of in-game items for wishlists and auctions.

### Guild Treasury
Track guild currency, donations, and expenditures.

### Guild Storage

Manage guild bank inventory with checkout/return system.

### Party Builder

Drag-and-drop party composition with role requirements.

### Loadouts

Save and share gear/skill loadouts per class.

### Applications

Customizable application forms for recruiting new members.

### Announcements

Post announcements to Discord and the web dashboard.

### Absence Management

Declare absences with automatic Discord role management.

### Roster Audit

Audit guild members' gear, enchants, and gems with data from the Blizzard API.

### Guild Report

Guild-wide reports with class distribution, item level charts, and raid readiness.

### WoW API Sync

Automatic roster and character data sync via the Blizzard API.

## Your bot output for WoW

The CoGM bot posts directly to your Discord server when your guild takes action.

# Level Up Your WoW Classic Experience: Essential Discord Bots
Dec 3, 2025 By Emily Carter 11 min read 51 views

Featured image for Level Up Your WoW Classic Experience: Essential Discord Bots Level Up Your WoW Classic Experience: Essential Discord Bots

## Level Up Your WoW Classic Experience: Essential Discord Bots

Hey guys! Are you diving headfirst into the nostalgic world of World of Warcraft Classic? Awesome! Getting back into Azeroth is a blast. But let’s be real, managing a guild, coordinating raids, and staying on top of everything can feel like herding cats sometimes. That’s where **_Discord bots_** swoop in to save the day! They’re like having a digital assistant, a raid scheduler, and a helpful community manager all rolled into one. In this article, we’ll explore some of the **_best Discord bots_** for WoW Classic, how they can enhance your gameplay, and how to get them up and running. Think of it as your ultimate guide to leveling up your Discord game alongside your character level.
We will also include useful information on what the bots are for and how to use them. So, get ready to transform your Discord server into a well-oiled machine ready for Molten Core and beyond. Remember, a well-managed Discord server is the backbone of any successful guild or community. Whether you are a casual player or a hardcore raider, integrating these bots can make your WoW Classic experience smoother, more organized, and a whole lot more fun. Let’s get started, shall we?

## Why Use Discord Bots in WoW Classic?

Alright, so why bother with these bots, anyway? Well, let me tell you, **_Discord bots_** for WoW Classic are more than just fancy gadgets; they’re essential tools that streamline your gameplay experience. They handle a ton of tedious tasks, letting you focus on the good stuff: slaying dragons, collecting epic loot, and hanging out with your guildies. First off, they’re fantastic for **_scheduling raids_** .
No more endless back-and-forth trying to find a time that works for everyone. Bots can help create polls, send reminders, and even automatically update your calendar when things change. Secondly, bots are super helpful for **_managing your guild_** . They can handle member applications, track attendance, and even assign roles based on your character’s class or specialization. This helps keep everything organized and ensures everyone knows their place in the raiding party. They also offer real-time **_information and updates_** . Imagine getting notified instantly when a boss is killed, when a specific item drops, or when a new event starts. These bots pull data from various sources, keeping you informed on everything from server populations to the latest news about the game. Additionally, these bots improve **_communication and community building_** . They offer features like custom commands, integrated music, and fun games that bring your guild closer together.
They can also create dedicated channels for specific topics, like class discussions or loot distribution, making it easier to have targeted conversations. Lastly, and this is a big one, they can handle a lot of the **_administrative work_** , leaving you and your officers free to actually play the game and focus on strategy, rather than just managing spreadsheets. Basically, **_using Discord bots_** in WoW Classic is like upgrading from a rusty old sword to a shiny, enchanted blade. It gives you an edge, makes things easier, and allows you to enjoy the game to the fullest. They save time, reduce stress, and help you build a stronger community. So, why not give your WoW Classic adventure a boost?

## Top Discord Bots for WoW Classic

Now, let’s get into the good stuff: the bots themselves! There’s a whole world of **_Discord bots_** out there, but we’ll focus on the ones that are particularly awesome for WoW Classic. Consider these bots as the backbone of your Discord server.
They are designed to streamline your communication, management, and overall WoW Classic experience. This list includes bots that help with scheduling, information, guild management, and community engagement. Here’s a rundown of some of the **_top Discord bots_** that will make your life easier and your guild stronger:

For more on this topic, see [Experience 'Almost Love' In 8D Audio: A Sonic Adventure](https://mc.race-dezert.comexperience-almost-love-in-8d-audio-a-sonic-adventure-1767647254) .

### 1\. GuildBot

GuildBot is a must-have for any guild looking to stay organized. Think of it as your **_guild’s personal assistant_** . It’s designed specifically for managing guilds, tracking attendance, handling applications, and assigning roles. **_GuildBot_** helps automate many of the repetitive tasks involved in guild management. With GuildBot, you can easily create and manage member applications. This ensures that only the right people are joining your guild.

...

It has a straightforward interface that makes it easy to set up and customize to fit your guild’s specific needs. Whether you’re a seasoned guild leader or just starting out, GuildBot is a great choice. It is an amazing bot that can save you time and headaches.

### 2\. RemindMe

Okay, guys, let’s talk about **_RemindMe_** . This bot is the ultimate reminder tool. If you want to remember raid times, daily quests, or anything else in WoW Classic, **_RemindMe_** has you covered. It’s super simple to set up and use, and it’s an absolute game-changer for keeping everyone on the same page. The main purpose of RemindMe is to help you stay on schedule. You can set up reminders for anything: raid times, important events, daily tasks, or anything else you need to remember. You can schedule reminders for specific times, days of the week, or even recurring events. This way, you will never miss a raid again.

...

This bot also integrates with other services. You can connect it to your Discord server and set up notifications for when new content is released. It also offers a set of custom commands that provide a lot of information. WildBot’s user-friendly interface makes it easy to navigate and find the information you need. The commands are straightforward and provide quick access to the data you need. This bot saves time. With all this information at your fingertips, you will save time searching the web, keeping you informed about everything related to WoW Classic. This makes it easier to stay ahead of the game. For anyone looking to stay informed about what is happening in the game, WildBot is a must-have.

### 4\. EventBot

EventBot is your go-to bot for **_scheduling and managing events_** in your Discord server. This bot is like having a personal event planner for your guild or community, helping you coordinate raids, PvP events, and other gatherings with ease.
**_EventBot_** is extremely useful. First and foremost, EventBot excels at creating and managing events. You can easily create events with details like the event name, date, time, and description. This ensures everyone knows what the event is about and what to expect. This bot also helps with automated reminders. EventBot can automatically send out reminders before your events, ensuring everyone is aware and ready to participate. You can customize the reminder frequency to fit your needs. EventBot also makes **_RSVP management_** easy. Members can RSVP to events with simple commands, and the bot keeps track of who’s attending. This makes it easier to plan and prepare for your events. The user-friendly interface is also a plus. Creating and managing events is simple, even for those who are new to bot usage. The bot has easy commands to help you get started right away. This is all integrated, so everyone is on the same page. Moreover, EventBot streamlines the event planning process.
It saves you time and effort by automating many of the tasks involved in event management. It is a fantastic tool that makes it easy to organize events and coordinate with your community.

### 5\. ZappyBot

ZappyBot is an all-in-one bot designed to handle a variety of tasks in your Discord server. It’s like a Swiss Army knife of bots, offering a range of features from moderation to fun commands. It also has features to help with **_community engagement_** . It provides a mix of features to help you enhance your Discord server’s functionality and keep your community engaged. First, it offers **_moderation tools_** . ZappyBot can help you manage your server, including features like banning users, kicking members, and muting troublemakers. This helps keep your server a welcoming and safe environment. Next, ZappyBot has **_fun commands_** . ZappyBot includes various fun and engaging commands to spice up your Discord server.
